endpoints.desc: Legacy internal endpoint for direct model chatting.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/chat', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: Executes raw CEL (cluaiz Execution Language) scripts natively. Used for dynamic agentic logic.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/cel/execute \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"script": "return 42;"}'

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"script": "return 42;"}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/cel/execute', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: Dynamic ecosystem execution. Directly calls an exposed FFI function inside a component (e.g. extension, plugin).

params.name: args
params.desc: Array of arguments to pass to the function.

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/execute/plugin_name/function_name \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"args": ["query", 10]}'

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"args": ["query", 10]}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/execute/plugin_name/function_name', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: Directly chunks, embeds, and ingests a file into the local vector namespace (LMDB).

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/ingest/file \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"file_path": "/docs/architecture.pdf", "namespace": "core"}'

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "file_path": "/docs/architecture.pdf",
    "namespace": "core"
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/ingest/file', json=payload)
print(res.json())
